_comment: COPY THIS to .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored) — nothing reads this file directly.
It lives here, tracked, so a fresh clone of this repo does not spend its first session
confirming every command. That is the pattern /rails-flow:setup-flow §2c now scaffolds for
users, and this repo was not following it — telling people to do something we did not do.
WHY A BROAD LIST STILL PROMPTS: maintenance commands are compound pipelines
(`python3 scripts/x.py | grep y | sed z`). The whole string is evaluated, so ONE unlisted
binary anywhere in the chain re-prompts all of it. `grep` missing is enough on its own.
DELIBERATELY ABSENT: rm, curl, wget, kill/pkill, chmod, package installers. Those destroy
work, reach the network, or mutate a toolchain a later step trusts — a prompt is correct
friction there even during an unattended run. For no friction at all, choose a permission
MODE deliberately rather than arriving at one by extending this list.
MERGE, never overwrite: if your local file already has entries, add only what is missing.
